note: The clip-pack row (Characters, 2026-10-18; Dom's data-layer rule). scripts/character/add-weapon-packs.mjs and tests/creature-packs.test.ts read every number and list here. donors: the hero-rig GLB each weapon's Warhammer_/Maul_/Scythe_/Trident_ clips come from (dwarf.glb and minotaur.glb packs are retargeted to those bodies and are never donors). retargets: identity copies the donor's keys; goblin is scripts/build-warrior.mjs BUILD.goblin (hunch = [bone, degrees] post-rotated about the bone's rest sideways axis; bob = the pelvis sways rest + bob * (hero - hero rest)). bodies: which body file carries which weapons' packs, through which retarget (a kind's world body and its engine body carry the same clip names: tests/world-bodies.test.ts). pelvisTolerance: the most a pack's pelvis key may differ from the retarget rule (tests/creature-packs.test.ts).
